Map source IDs to the client copy; copied IDs may differ. Reject mismatched names/types/ownership and unlisted consumers.
Protect any retained Purchase, Manufacturing, POS, Repairs or stock-valuation consumer; Inventory removal is blocked until that dependency is removed or replaced by an approved plan.
Determine whether the two known print templates are transferred into the client copy; their exact IDs are not captured here.
Export business history and attachments and demonstrate recovery before destructive pruning; local schema snapshots alone are insufficient.
Freeze and drain/quarantine in-flight Inventory/Scan Requests processes; do not retry historical posting/scanning fixtures.
Remove/replace genuine Inventory references inside retained objects only after a separately reviewed field/node/component-level delta; never remove a mixed CRM/Sales workflow or page wholesale.
